title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Arevik Avedian is a Lecturer on Law and Director of Empirical Research Services at Harvard Law School. Professor Avedian’s teaching and research interests center around empirical law. Before joining HLS, she taught at University of California, Riverside and California State University, Fullerton. Professor Avedian holds a Ph.D. in world politics and methods and a M.A. […]
